blocks.html: If someone you care about is exhibiting odd signs, you might want to know how to tell if someone is on cocaine. Being able to recognize the signs of cocaine use will help you determine when a family member or friend might need your help.

blocks.html: Cocaine is a highly addictive stimulant. There is a high risk of cocaine abuse and addiction because of how quickly the effects kick in and how short their lifespan is. For example, if somebody uses cocaine, they might feel the effects very quickly, so if they are abusing drugs to numb their pain or give them energy, cocaine will be fast-acting. But, cocaine also wears off in about 30 minutes. This means that larger and larger amounts of cocaine become necessary the more someone uses it just to get that same fast response for that same amount of time.
